editorial_policy: Rewritten example sentences are original AshitaKanji text; external dictionaries were used only to validate usage.

decisions.evidence: JMdict has 平ら/たいら (1506930) and 平らげる/たいらげる; 平 alone is never read たいら. The attached example (すしを三人前平げる, '먹어 치우다') belongs to 平らげる, not to '평평하다', which is already covered by w_4864cdd403be8cb0 (N3 平ら).

example.jp: 彼は寿司を三人前平らげた。

decisions.evidence: JMdict 1440930 marks 纏める as a rarely used kanji form (rK); the standard modern spelling is まとめる.

example.jp: 複数の資料を一つにまとめる。

decisions.evidence: JMdict 1577980 marks 居る as a rarely used kanji form (rK) for いる; an N5 card should carry the kana spelling.

example.jp: 教室には学生が三人いる。
